sub_sector.value: Network test and assurance; precision optics; resilient PNT

manufacturing_type.detail: Discrete test equipment and optical filters, plus process manufacturing for optical coatings.

product_complexity.detail: Network test and measurement, resilient positioning, navigation and timing, and optical coatings and filters for spatial sensing.

production_role.detail: Sells finished test equipment, provides repair and calibration, and supplies optical coatings and filters for integration into customer products.

end_market_exposure.detail: Communications networks, data centers, military and aerospace, railways, first responders, consumer electronics, automotive sensing, industrial applications, and anti-counterfeiting.
